title: St. Jude Novena
description: A nine-day novena asking St. Jude to intercede for difficult and impossible intentions.

days.title: Day 1
days.body:
[[invocation]]In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.[[/invocation]]

[[plain]]Most holy St. Jude – apostle, martyr and friend of Jesus, today I ask that you pray for me and my intentions![[/plain]]

[[italic]](State your intentions here)[[/italic]]

[[plain]]You are the patron of the impossible. Pray for me and my intentions! O St. Jude, pray that God’s grace and mercy will cover my intentions. Pray for the impossible if it is God’s will.[[/plain]]

[[plain]]Pray that I may have the grace to accept God’s holy will even if it is painful and difficult for me.[[/plain]]

[[plain]]St. Jude, you loved our Lord, help me to love Him more.[[/plain]]

[[plain]]O St. Jude, pray for me that I may grow in faith, hope and love and in the grace of Jesus Christ. Pray for these intentions, but most of all pray that I may join you in heaven with God for all eternity.[[/plain]]

[[plain]]Amen.[[/plain]]

[[invocation]]In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.[[/invocation]]
